name: ember
description: Ember — TanStack Start / NestJS / Kotlin Multiplatform boilerplate

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/api run test:e2e && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
